slots.ev: 清晨到樟宜準備出勤，航廈已經有旅客了

ppl.act: 拖著行李走向登機門、在座位區等
ppl.wear: 旅客的衣服，外套、帽 T、拖著行李箱

slots.pl: 樟宜機場的航廈走道，清晨，玻璃外停著一架飛機
slots.pl_en: in a Changi terminal walkway in the early morning, an aircraft parked outside the glass
slots.ac: 她拉著行李箱走過去，另一手把包的帶子往肩上撥
slots.ac_en: She is walking through pulling her cabin case, her other hand pushing the bag strap back up her shoulder.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：制服與時差／小習慣：落地第一件事是把包頭放下來（此刻還沒放）
slots.of: 深藍色空服制服套裝，裙長及膝
slots.of_en: a navy cabin-crew uniform suit with a knee-length skirt
slots.of_s: 標誌性配額以外的正規制服／色盤：深藍
slots.li: 航廈的冷白照明加上玻璃外的清晨天光，整體是冷的
slots.li_en: The terminal's cool white lighting mixes with early daylight through the glass, and the whole scene reads cold.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「冷調的出勤場景」／氛圍原句：「機場冷光與飯店暖光的兩地切換」
slots.fa: 上班的臉，禮貌但有距離
slots.fa_en: Her working face: polite and at a distance.
slots.fa_s: 氛圍原句：「乾淨、有距離的高級感」

slots.ev: 落地進飯店房間，第一件事是把包頭放下來，再點那款蠟燭
slots.pl: 一間剛落地的飯店房間，窗簾已經被她拉開，行李攤在地上
slots.pl_en: in a hotel room she has just landed into, the curtains already pulled open by her and the case lying open on the floor
slots.ac: 她坐在床沿把髮夾一根一根拆下來，包頭鬆開一半
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the edge of the bed taking the pins out one at a time, the chignon already half undone.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：落地第一件事是把包頭放下來／飯店房間一定先拉開窗簾
slots.of: 制服襯衫還穿著，扣子解開兩顆，裙子換成了飯店的浴袍下襬
slots.of_en: still in her uniform shirt with the top two buttons undone, the skirt already swapped for hotel-robe fabric below
slots.of_s: 私下核心：制服脫下後的房間
slots.li: 床頭一盞飯店的暖黃燈在她側前方，房間其餘部分暗
slots.li_en: One warm hotel bedside lamp sits to the side and in front of her, and the rest of the room is dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「飯店暖光」／後製原句：「暖調的房間場景」
slots.fa: 時差還在臉上，眼睛往下看著手上的夾子
slots.fa_en: The time difference is still on her face and her eyes are down on the pins in her hand.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：乾式的、跟時差和行李有關的自嘲
slots.hair_en: a chignon halfway taken down, loose sections falling

slots.ev: 回新加坡的家，時差還沒調回來，凌晨三點還醒著
slots.pil: 私下 / 一個人的房間
slots.pl: 她新加坡公寓的床上，凌晨三點，整間房只有一盞燈
slots.pl_en: across the bed in her Singapore apartment at three in the morning, one lamp on in the whole flat
slots.ac: 她橫躺在床上，一隻手臂枕在頭下面，另一隻放在身側
slots.ac_en: She is lying across the bed with one arm tucked under her head and the other resting at her side.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：她的性感由「一個人的房間 + 時差」構成，安靜而私密
slots.of_en: a two-piece white silk sleep set
slots.of_s: 私下核心：絲質睡衣／色盤：白
slots.li: 那盞燈在她正前方低處，床的另一半落在暗裡
slots.li_en: The lamp is low and directly in front of her, and the far half of the bed falls into shadow.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「暖調的房間場景。維持清晰高質感」
slots.fa: 完全醒著但很平靜，看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Completely awake but calm, looking at the lens.
slots.hair_en: down and slightly messy from the pillow

slots.ev: 在家的日子完全不化妝，這天早上也是
slots.pl: 她新加坡公寓的浴室，早上，檯面上只有一瓶卸妝和那款蠟燭
slots.pl_en: in the bathroom of her Singapore apartment in the morning, only a bottle of cleanser and that same candle on the counter
slots.ac: 她一手撐著洗手台邊緣，身體微微側著
slots.ac_en: One hand rests on the edge of the basin and her body is turned very slightly to the side.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：在家的日子完全不化妝／行李裡永遠有同一款蠟燭
slots.of: 白色棉質背心配低腰短褲
slots.of_en: a white cotton vest with low-slung shorts
slots.li: 高窗的日光從側面進來，浴室是亮的，不是單一燈源
slots.li_en: Daylight from a high window comes in from the side and the bathroom is bright throughout, not lit by a single lamp.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「維持清晰高質感，膚色白皙」——在家的白天不套用出勤的冷調
slots.fa: 完全素顏，很直接地看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Completely without makeup, looking very directly at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：英文為主、簡潔有禮

slots.ev: 在東京那一晚不想待在房間，出去走了一段還開著的街
slots.pl: 東京一條晚上還開著幾間小店的街，招牌的光落在路面上
slots.pl_en: on a Tokyo street where a few small places are still open at night, sign light falling across the road surface
slots.ac: 她站在店與店之間停了一下，兩手都空著
slots.ac_en: She has stopped for a moment between two shopfronts, both hands empty.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：帳號一開始只是記錄各個城市
slots.of: 冷灰色長大衣，裡面是深色的貼身洋裝
slots.of_en: a long cool-grey coat over a dark fitted dress
slots.li: 招牌與店面的光從兩側來，街道深處暗
slots.li_en: Sign and shopfront light reaches her from both sides, and the street runs dark further down.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「乾淨、有距離的高級感」
slots.fa_en: Quiet, looking across to the other side of the street.
slots.hair_en: down, out of the chignon, with a kink where it was pinned
